title: Lord send revival
rawText:
{c: Verse 1}
[C2]  Peace like a r[G]iver wash ove[D4]r me
[C2]  Immerse me in wa[G]ter as deep as th[D4]e sea
[C2]  Hide me in lo[G]ve, Your healing em[D4]brace
Peace like a [C2]river,   [G]    wash ove[D4]r me

{c: Chorus}
As I worship Your m[C2]ajesty    [G]
I worship Your [D]ho - [D4]ly Na[D]me
Jesus, my e[C]verything  [G]
All that I [D]am    [D4]is    Y[D]ours

{c: Verse 2}
[C2]  Come Holy Spi[G]rit, rain down on [D4] me
[C2]  Break open the h[G]eavens and drench the u[D4]nseen
[C2]  Pour out Your pr[G]esence as I pour out You[D4]r praise
Come Holy S[C2]pirit,  [G]    Lord, have You[D4]r way

{c: Bridge 1}
[C2]  Open the h[G]eavens, fling wide the g[D4]ates
[D]Flood ev'ry [D4]heart with m[D]ercy
[C2]  Pour out Your pr[G]esence, inhabit our pr[D4]aise
As [D]we cry h[D4]oly, [G/B]holy
[C2]  Who[G]a, who[D]a, as we cry, holy, [G/B]holy

{c: Bridge 2}
[G/B]Lord, send rev[C2]ival, Lord, send it n[G]ow
A move of Your S[D]pirit, heaven break out
Come now in p[C2]ower, cover this la[G]nd
Like You've done it bef[D]ore, would You do it again?
